agent_operating_rules: Work on a new git branch. Do not commit directly to main.
Execute steps strictly in order. Do not set any step.passed=true until that step's test passes exactly as written.
After each step passes, commit with the step id in the commit message (e.g., 'S03: ...').
If a step fails, do not proceed. Fix the failure within the same step until the test passes.
Prefer deleting nothing until the final 'Delete confirmed dead code' step; move to legacy/ or experiments/ first.

assumptions.ffmpeg: optional; required only for real audio runs, not for smoke tests
assumptions.gpu: not required for tests; tests must not require WhisperX model downloads

steps.title: Create clean working branch and baseline snapshot
steps.objective: Ensure a reproducible starting point and capture a baseline inventory before changes.
actions: Create a new branch named `repo-cleanup` from the current default branch.
Ensure the working tree is clean (no uncommitted changes).
Create `docs/BASELINE.md` containing: current commit hash, python version, OS info, and a top-level file tree (depth 2).
Add a `docs/BASELINE.md` section titled 'Baseline command outputs' and paste outputs of: `git rev-parse HEAD`, `python --version`, `pip --version`, `git status`.

test.name: Baseline snapshot exists and working tree is clean
test.pass_criteria: All commands exit with code 0 AND all expected conditions are satisfied.

steps.title: Remove committed secrets and introduce safe config template
steps.objective: Ensure no Hugging Face (or other) tokens are committed and configs are safe-by-default.
actions: Edit `pipeline_config.yaml` so that any secret fields are empty placeholders (e.g., set `hf_token` to an empty string).
Add `pipeline_config.local.yaml` to `.gitignore` for developer-specific overrides and secrets.
Create `pipeline_config.example.yaml` as a safe template suitable for committing. It must not contain real tokens or user-specific absolute paths.
Update README or docs to instruct: copy `pipeline_config.example.yaml` to `pipeline_config.local.yaml` and set secrets via environment variables or local file.
Search the repo for token-like strings and remove/replace them with placeholders.
deliverables: pipeline_config.yaml (sanitized OR replaced by example + documented usage)
docs/SECURITY_NOTES.md (new) describing how secrets are provided

test.name: No tokens committed; configs are safe
expected: Search results do not show an actual token value committed in YAML files
pipeline_config.example.yaml parses and contains only placeholders for hf_token
test.pass_criteria: All commands exit with code 0 AND all expected conditions are satisfied.

steps.notes: If a token was previously committed, rotate it immediately. Optional but recommended: rewrite git history to purge the secret.

steps.title: Make pipeline_config defaults portable across machines
steps.objective: Eliminate hard-coded machine-specific paths and ensure configs resolve relative paths predictably.
actions: Replace any absolute Windows-specific `project_root` or `pipeline_root` defaults in committed YAML templates with relative, portable defaults.
Use placeholders consistently: `{project_root}`, `{pipeline_root}` and resolve them via the shared loader.
Ensure `project_root` can default to the repo root if not explicitly provided (document this).
deliverables: docs/CONFIGURATION.md (new) describing which config file(s) are used by: UI, hot-folder mode, and CLI scripts

test.name: Config template has no machine-specific absolute paths
commands:
python - << 'PY'
import pathlib, re
text=pathlib.Path('pipeline_config.example.yaml').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
# Heuristic checks for common absolute path patterns
assert not re.search(r"\b[A-Za-z]:\\\\", text), 'windows absolute path found'
assert '/Users/' not in text and '/home/' not in text, 'unix home absolute path found'
print('ok')
PY
expected: No Windows drive paths (e.g., C:\\...) in pipeline_config.example.yaml
No hard-coded /Users/... or /home/... paths in pipeline_config.example.yaml
test.pass_criteria: All commands exit with code 0 AND all expected conditions are satisfied.

steps.title: Standardize config loading across stage scripts
steps.objective: Remove duplicate config merge/path-resolution code and make all stage scripts use `pipeline_config.load_pipeline_config`.
actions: In `align_make.py` and `build_training_pair_standalone.py`, remove or deprecate the local `_recursive_update` / `_resolve_paths` helpers.
Import and use `load_pipeline_config(DEFAULT_SETTINGS, yaml_path=args.config_file)` from `pipeline_config.py` instead.
Make the CLI flags consistent across scripts: keep existing flags used by orchestrators (`--config-file`, etc.) but ensure they are implemented and documented.
Ensure the resolved config dictionary is used for all file paths and settings.
deliverables: Any removed helper functions are deleted or left only if still used elsewhere with justification in comments

steps.title: Make heavy dependencies import-lazy with clear error messages
steps.objective: Allow the repo to be installed/inspected without WhisperX/Torch/GPU dependencies, while failing gracefully when those features are invoked.
actions: Refactor `align_make.py` so importing the module does not require `whisperx` or `torch` to be installed.
Move `import whisperx` and `import torch` inside the function(s) that actually use them (or wrap imports in try/except with a clear RuntimeError when missing).
Ensure the existing guidance message is surfaced when resources are missing (do not silently ignore).
deliverables: align_make.py no longer imports whisperx/torch at module import time
Clear error message on missing dependencies when ASR is invoked

test.name: Module import works without WhisperX/Torch installed

test.name: Stage3 produces a non-empty SRT with monotonic timestamps
commands: # If demo.enriched.json is not committed as a fixture, generate it via S07 first.

python - << 'PY'
import re
text=open('tests/_artifacts/demo.srt','r',encoding='utf-8').read().strip()
assert '-->' in text
# Parse timestamps and ensure non-decreasing starts
pat=re.compile(r"(\d\d):(\d\d):(\d\d),(\d\d\d)\s*-->\s*(\d\d):(\d\d):(\d\d),(\d\d\d)")
prev_start=0
for m in pat.finditer(text):
    h,mi,s,ms,eh,emi,es,ems=map(int,m.groups())
    start=((h*3600+mi*60+s)*1000+ms)
    end=((eh*3600+emi*60+es)*1000+ems)
    assert end>=start
    assert start>=prev_start
    prev_start=start
print('ok')
PY
expected: SRT file exists and is non-empty
SRT contains at least one timestamp line
All cue end times are >= start times and starts are non-decreasing
test.pass_criteria: All commands exit with code 0 AND all expected conditions are satisfied.

Document the exact CLI flags used by orchestrators (from `ui/backend/pipelines.py` and `run_pipeline.py`).

test.pass_criteria: All commands exit with code 0 AND all expected conditions are satisfied.

actions: Create `experiments/` and `legacy/` directories (if not already present).
Move experimental alt scripts (e.g., docs/alt_build_training_pair_standalone.py) into `experiments/` and update references in docs.
Move superseded orchestration approaches (if the UI is canonical) into `legacy/` with a README explaining why.

legacy/ directory with moved legacy orchestrators or scripts
docs updated to point to new locations

actions: Update comments/docstrings in `run_pipeline.py` (and anywhere else) to correctly describe how config overrides work (YAML overrides loaded by `pipeline_config.py`).

steps.title: Delete code confirmed unused by tests and dependency scans
steps.objective: Remove truly dead leftovers to reduce maintenance surface area.
actions: Run a dependency scan (e.g., `python -m pip install vulture` and `vulture .`) and/or static grep to identify unused modules.
Only delete files that are not referenced by: UI runner, hot-folder runner (if still supported), scripts/smoke_e2e.py, or tests.
For each deleted file, add a note in `docs/DELETIONS.md` explaining why it is safe and what replaced it.
